releaseNotes:
## Weekly
- A saved booking change shows on the weekly page. Allergies, personal notes, the guest name, and room nights follow the save.
- Clearing an allergy or a matching personal note removes it from this week and later stays. A stay that has already ended keeps its old note.
- Print B&W uses black text and solid borders. CLEAN is a black box. Lines that only say “No allergies” or “None” are left off the allergy row.

## Bookings
- Clearing someone’s room is saved. An empty room choice no longer keeps the previous room.
